author: Marauder6612

title: Great for studying when you have ADHD
body: Love the interface of this app and how customizable it is. Only complaint is that when in the middle of a ”cycle” if I decide to shorten to 3 rounds instead of 4 until a long break sometimes it just starts going over (like 4/3) and doesn’t give the long break. Also, the fact that skipping doesn’t give you a round is annoying. Sometimes I forget to put the timer back on and do a round without it. Then you have to set the timer to 1 minute so it gives you the round and moves to break. Minor things though, still a great app that I use daily.

author: Rovionynnyt

title: Easy to use
body:
I have the free version. I have enjoyed using the app and it’s very helpful. Seeing how many rounds you have done is very motivating for myself. Since 25minutes studying and 5 minute break is the best for me I haven’t felt like I need the payed version. I really recommend this app to everyone.

Much easier to keep track of rounds and breaks with this than normal phone timer. 

The layout is simple and makes it easy to use. Not too much on the screen and being able to skip the short and long breaks is good if you are in a flow with the studying.
author: klassismia

title: Helps procrastinators and workaholics
body: I have problems with working too much and too long on some days and then being too tired and fed up on the next day to do anything. Focus Keeper schedules breaks and does it very nicely. I am happy with the default setting but option to edit them is an important feature. Focus Keeper lives up to its name as it also helps to remain focus until the next break. Very good app, highly recommended.
